name: Servier Medical Art
description: A massive collection of over 3,000 free medical and scientific vector images. Fully editable, high-resolution vector illustrations for medical research, student presentations, and healthcare publications.

name: PubMed (NCBI)
description: The gold-standard research database featuring over 36 million citations for biomedical literature, clinical research, life science journals, and online scientific books.

name: BioRender
description: The premiere scientific illustration tool designed for scientists and students. Create publication-quality medical diagrams and cellular pathways in minutes.

name: BioDigital Human
description: An interactive 3D human body platform. Explore anatomy, disease conditions, and surgical procedures in an immersive WebGL 3D environment.

name: MedlinePlus
description: Trusted health and medical information from the U.S. National Library of Medicine. Features detailed guides on diseases, tests, and medical drugs.

name: InnerBody Anatomy
description: Free interactive anatomical guide showcasing hundreds of interactive body maps covering skeletal, cardiovascular, and nervous systems.
